pairs: Liber generationis Jesu Christi filii David,
The book of the lineage of Jesus Christ, the son of David,
Salmon autem genuit Booz de Rahab.
And Salmon conceived Boaz by Rahab.
Booz autem genuit Obed ex Ruth. Obed autem genuit Jesse.
And Boaz conceived Obed by Ruth.
David autem rex genuit Salomonem ex ea quæ fuit Uriæ.
And Jesse conceived king David. And king David conceived Solomon, by her who had been the wife of Uriah.
et fratres ejus in transmigratione Babylonis.
and his brothers in the transmigration of Babylon.
And after the transmigration of Babylon,
Jacob autem genuit Joseph virum Mariæ,
And Jacob conceived Joseph, the husband of Mary,
Omnes itaque generationes ab Abraham usque ad David,
all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations;
et a David usque ad transmigrationem Babylonis,
and from David to the transmigration of Babylon,
et a transmigratione Babylonis usque ad Christum,
and from the transmigration of Babylon to the Christ,
Christi autem generatio sic erat: cum esset desponsata mater ejus Maria Joseph,
Now the procreation of the Christ occurred in this way. After his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph,
antequam convenirent inventa est in utero habens de Spiritu Sancto.
before they lived together, she was found to have conceived in her womb by the Holy Spirit.
Joseph autem vir ejus cum esset justus,
since he was just and was not willing to hand her over,
preferred to send her away secretly.
But while thinking over these things,
ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis ei,
an Angel of the Lord appeared to him in his sleep,
noli timere accipere Mariam conjugem tuam:
quod enim in ea natum est,
do not be afraid to accept Mary as your wife.
For what has been formed in her is of the Holy Spirit.
And she shall give birth to a son.
And you shall call his name JESUS.
ipse enim salvum faciet populum suum a peccatis eorum.
For he shall accomplish the salvation of his people from their sins.”
Now all this occurred in order to fulfill what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet,
ut adimpleretur quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem:
Ecce virgo in utero habebit, et pariet filium:
“Behold, a virgin shall conceive in her womb,
and she shall give birth to a son.
And they shall call his name Emmanuel, which means: God is with us.”
fecit sicut præcepit ei angelus Domini,
did just as the Angel of the Lord had instructed him,
and he accepted her as his wife.
Et non cognoscebat eam donec peperit filium suum primogenitum:
And he knew her not, yet she bore her son, the firstborn.
And he called his name JESUS.
